free_tier.stated: Trusted Platform: 256 MB per player (Managed Partners) / 64 MB per player (Creators Program). Universal Platform: 64 MB per player. Global: 256 MB. No total-title byte cap published.

egress.terms: Not metered separately in the Title Storage docs; access is through Xbox services.

record.tooling: Xbox services REST endpoints + GDK; data must be hex or base64 encoded because Title Storage 'doesn't process encoded data'.
record.chaining: 256 MB per player x unlimited players, but the per-write encoding overhead (base64 = +33%) eats the ceiling, and Managed Partner status is a gate for the 256 MB tier.
record.limits_note: Per-object-cap: 64 MB per player on the Creator-Program tier; request-rate: ~60 reads or writes per hour per session, then throttled. Binary must be base64/hex encoded. Retention: not documented as expiring. Data persists with the title.
record.reliability_note: Throttles to roughly one call per minute averaged over an hour-long session, so bulk transfer is painful; the 256 MB tier requires Managed Partner status rather than self-serve signup.

evidence.proved: quota table: 'Trusted Platform | 256 MB per player | 64 MB per player', 'Universal Platform | 64 MB per player', 'Global | 256 MB'; 'a title can make 60 reads or writes at the beginning of a session, but no more for the remainder of the hour'
